understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, then progress through all levels until the run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement used MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) unless blocked by walls/bounds or other collision rules; some adjacent objects could be pushable, allowing the selected piece to move while pushing the object in the same direction. Walls acted as solid obstacles that could prevent movement, though the 'movement.*_blocked' flags were only hints and not guaranteed outcomes. If multiple selectables existed, control could be switched by issuing CLICK with a target_position matching the pixel coordinates of another selectable.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each KA59 level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' in the semantic grid is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time, then progress through all levels until the run reports WIN.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement used MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN to shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) unless blocked by walls/bounds or other collision rules; some adjacent objects could be pushable, allowing the selected piece to move while pushing the object in the same direction. Walls acted as solid obstacles that could prevent movement, though the 'movement.*_blocked' flags were only hints and not guaranteed outcomes. If multiple selectables existed, control could be switched by issuing CLICK with a target_position matching the pixel coordinates of another selectable.
